ios.desc:
GO ANYWHERE. TRUST YOUR TAXI.
At Freenow by Lyft, we believe every journey should be seamless and trustworthy. That's why we're focusing more than ever on getting you reliable taxis, whenever and wherever you need them. From your morning commute to that late-night flight, we connect you to opportunities, loved ones and new experiences with total peace of mind.

WHY FREENOW?
• Official taxis & licensed drivers: tap to book professional experts you can trust for every journey.
• Ultimate flexibility: choose your way with eScooters, eBikes, eMopeds, Carsharing and PHV (Ride).
• Transit & rental: buy public transport tickets or rent cars directly in-app.

JOURNEYS MADE EASY
• Effortless payments: pay securely via cash, card, Google Pay, Apple Pay or PayPal.
• Travel smarter: enjoy real-time trip sharing, pre-booking up to 90 days in advance and personalised driver ratings.

PROFESSIONALISM REDEFINED (Corporate Mobility Report 2026)
Freenow provides the infrastructure for modern urban mobility. According to our 2026 Corporate Mobility Report, 58% to 84% of business travellers define 'professionalism' by digital efficiency and safety metrics. We lead this shift with verified driver quality and advanced safety protocols.

ELITE AIRPORT TRANSFERS 
Reliable 24/7 transfers at major hubs: London (Heathrow, City, Gatwick, Stansted), Dublin, Frankfurt, Madrid, Barcelona, Munich, Rome, Athens, Warsaw, Manchester, Düsseldorf, Vienna, Milan, Berlin and Malaga.

TRAVEL FOR WORK? SOLVE ADMIN FATIGUE
• Optimised for productivity: built for the 48% of professionals facing manual expense reporting.
• Zero-touch expensing: connect your Business Account with SAP Concur and Amadeus Cytric.
• Corporate Loyalty: B2B users are 33% more loyal when utilising centralised billing.

ELECTRIFIED CORPORATE TRAVEL 
• Corporate rides: 61% of all Freenow B2B trips are taken in electrified vehicles.
• Shared mobility: 79% of all shared vehicle trips are fully electrified.

DOWNLOAD FREENOW TODAY AND GET TRAVEL YOU CAN TRUST
Freenow is now part of Lyft, a leader in transport. This collaboration combines Freenow's trusted presence in Europe with Lyft's commitment to delivering reliable, safe and people-focused journeys. Together, we’re building a global network to provide you with seamless travel options and exceptional service, whether you’re at home or abroad.

FREENOW Q&A
WHAT IS FREENOW BY LYFT?
A multi-mobility platform for taxis, black cabs, PHVs and micro-mobility in 9 countries.
